name: singlet_abundance_celltype_proportion_test
title: Cell-type proportion differential abundance test
description: Tests which predefined cell types change in relative abundance between conditions, with donors or libraries as replicates and all types modelled jointly. The default method sccoda fits a Bayesian Dirichlet-multinomial and calls types by expected FDR; propeller gives a per-type transformed-proportion test; tasccoda needs a cell-type tree. Reads sample, cell-type and covariate columns and writes per-type effects and calls; do not use it for neighbourhood-level or within-type expression changes.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

design.description: Sample, cell-type and covariate keys that define the sample-by-type composition table.

sample_key.description: obs column of the independent replicate (donor or library). Required.

celltype_key.description: obs column of predefined cell-type labels. Required.

formula.description: Sample-level design formula, for example 'condition' or 'condition + batch'. Required.

method.description: Test to run. sccoda is the default; tasccoda needs tasccoda.tree_key; propeller is the per-type check.

fdr.description: Target FDR for calls: posterior expected FDR for sccoda and tasccoda, Benjamini-Hochberg for propeller.

reference_cell_type.description: Cell type with zero effect, or automatic to let the method choose one. Ignored by propeller.

absence_threshold.description: Maximum zero fraction allowed for an automatically chosen reference.

donor_key.description: Optional donor column adding a donor random intercept for donors with several libraries (proposed extension).

tree_key.description: Name of the cell-type tree, such as a lineage or clustering hierarchy. Required when method is tasccoda.

lambda_0.description: Spike-and-slab penalty lambda_0 of the tascCODA prior.

lambda_1.description: Tree-aggregation penalty of the tascCODA prior.

theta.description: Global spike-and-slab mixing weight, held fixed rather than sampled.

transform.description: Variance-stabilising transform of per-sample cell-type proportions.

robust.description: Robust empirical-Bayes variance shrinkage in the limma fit.

trend.description: Fit a mean-variance trend before empirical-Bayes shrinkage.

device.description: Device for the JAX-based sccoda and tasccoda fits; propeller runs on CPU.

seed.description: Random seed for NUTS initialisation and draws.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory, device and model size without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example uns/celltype_proportion/effects. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Method, reference, sample and type counts, calls, expected FDR, acceptance rate and warnings for completed runs. Never raw posterior draws.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
